metadata.article_title: Proceedings in execution of decrees not affected.

article.title: Proceedings in execution of decrees not affected.
article.content:
4Proceedings in execution of decrees not affected.

Order 23, Rule 4
Nothing in this Order shall apply to any proceedings in execution of a decree or order.
